'''Minmo'''<ref name="Apexx Awakens">{{YJA|Apexx Awakens}}</ref> was a [[droid]] created by the [[droidsmith]] [[Rek Minuu]]<ref name="NewDroidFriends" /> sometime before or during [[230 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> They were a smaller version of a [[Rek's spider droid|spider droid]] model also made by Minuu.<ref name="NewDroidFriends" />
